evidence: Touches Guix build manifests and scripts in contrib/guix to produce static-pie Linux release binaries, labeled 'Build system'.
rationale: Switching official Linux release binaries to static-pie substantially expands Linux platform portability across distributions like Alpine, NixOS, and older systems while enabling aarch64 pointer authentication (#19075). Release integrity is directly impacted via custom glibc patches and ELF verification tooling changes.
